mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls indicate labor market tightening, boosting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls >0.2pp and PAYEMS rises >50k in a month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Strong residential investment growth above 1000k units signals robust consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000k units, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP growth above 2.0% annually indicates strong economic momentum, increasing corporate profit visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC over 5-year windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer price inflation and residential investment indicate inflationary demand pressures, boosting corporate pricing power and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises >0.3pp and HOUST rises >50k in a month, SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing output, increasing corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.05.
